collection_forward_count_basis: One policy forward per recorded decision, independently verified for every episode by the bound audit.
hash_chain: The first update begins at initial_parameter_hash; every next update begins at the preceding parameter_hash_after. Original full gradient records are bound by updates.json SHA256.
scope: One generated task with fixed seed 11. Each row describes one actual four-episode on-policy update; these sampled outcomes mix changing policies and are not fixed-final evaluation. No raw trajectories, observations, logits, weights or optimizer tensors are included.
timer_scope: Online collection includes clone/inventory/policy/execution; audit follows it. Both and loss_update_seconds are nested within broad fit/worker time. Do not add component sums to fit/worker/supervisor totals.
